headline: Round 1 is done: Vidarbha (by 160), Bengal (9 wkts), Maharashtra (127 runs) and Manipur (3 wkts) won on the final day for 10 outright results in 19 games, while champions J&K escaped MP at 88/7 in bad light.
UP, Baroda and Vidarbha all won outright, while champions J&K held on at 88/7 to concede only first-innings points to MP.
Hyderabad were the only Elite B winners; Punjab, Saurashtra and Andhra banked first-innings points, and Karun Nair's 145* was not enough to force a Karnataka win.
Gujarat, Bengal and Maharashtra all won outright — Vicky Ostwal's 5-50 sealed Maharashtra's 127-run win — while Jharkhand took first-innings points off Kerala.
Mumbai and Haryana are the outright winners; Rajasthan and Uttarakhand took first-innings points in draws against Tamil Nadu and Railways.
Manipur chased 228 from 84/5 to beat Mizoram behind Jotin Singh's 105, Meghalaya took first-innings points off Sikkim, and Nagaland won by forfeit.
